with recursive ancestors as ( select a.id as article_id, c.id as catalog_id, c.father_id from arte_rt_article a left join arte_rt_catalog c on c.id = a.catalog_id where a.id in #{id} union all select ancestors.article_id, c.id, c.father_id from arte_rt_catalog c inner join ancestors on c.id = ancestors.father_id ) select a.id, case when a.create_by = #{currentUser} then 'FULL_CONTROL' when max(case when s.resource_type = 'ARTICLE' then case s.permission when 'FULL_CONTROL' then 40 when 'READ_WRITE' then 30 when 'COMMENT' then 20 else 10 end when s.resource_type = 'CATALOG' then case coalesce(s.article_permission, 'READ') when 'FULL_CONTROL' then 40 when 'READ_WRITE' then 30 when 'COMMENT' then 20 else 10 end else 0 end) = 40 then 'FULL_CONTROL' when max(case when s.resource_type = 'ARTICLE' and s.permission = 'READ_WRITE' then 30 when s.resource_type = 'CATALOG' and s.article_permission = 'READ_WRITE' then 30 else 0 end) = 30 then 'READ_WRITE' when max(case when s.resource_type = 'ARTICLE' and s.permission = 'COMMENT' then 20 when s.resource_type = 'CATALOG' and s.article_permission = 'COMMENT' then 20 else 0 end) = 20 then 'COMMENT' else 'READ' end as effective_permission from arte_rt_article a left join ancestors on ancestors.article_id = a.id left join arte_rt_share s on ( (s.resource_type = 'ARTICLE' and s.resource_id = a.id) or (s.resource_type = 'CATALOG' and s.resource_id = ancestors.catalog_id) ) and ( (s.target_type = 'USER' and s.target_user = #{currentUser})
or (s.target_type = 'ROLE' and s.target_role in
#{role} )
) where a.id in #{id} group by a.id, a.create_by
